definitions.explanation: A chemical product used to whiten fabrics or remove stains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧。
examples.english: I wash white clothes with bleach.

examples.japanese: {漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦すぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{傷|いた}む→傷む：10061_itamu⟧。
examples.english: Using too much bleach will damage the fabric.

examples.japanese: ⟦{酸素|さんそ}→酸素：02830_sanso⟧⟦{系|けい}→系：noentry⟧{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{色柄物|いろがらもの}→色柄物：30767_irogaramono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Oxygen-based bleach can be used on colored and patterned items too.

notes:
{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい} is bleach — any whitening or stain-removing agent. Formation: ⟦{漂白|ひょうはく}→漂白：16995_hyouhaku⟧ 'bleaching' + ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ 'agent', the same suffix as in ⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧ and ⟦{柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい}→柔軟剤：07034_juunanzai⟧.

Japanese households distinguish two kinds, and the label always says which:
- ⟦{塩素|えんそ}→塩素：12143_enso⟧⟦{系|けい}→系：noentry⟧{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}: chlorine bleach — powerful, whites only, will strip colour
- ⟦{酸素|さんそ}→酸素：02830_sanso⟧⟦{系|けい}→系：noentry⟧{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}: oxygen bleach — gentler and safe on colours and patterns

Collocations:
- {漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to add bleach
- {漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦つける→漬ける：09861_tsukeru⟧: to soak something in bleach
- {漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: 'do not bleach' — the wording on a care label

Chlorine bleach must never be combined with acidic cleaners; Japanese products carry a prominent 「⟦まぜるな→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧」 ('do not mix — danger') warning for this reason.
